title: Events response
description: The response to GET {endpoint}/{id}/events, and to a POST with the wait query parameter. Spec sections 8.5 (Reading events) and 8.7 (State). Every successful read includes conversation_id, events, cursor, has_more, and the state fields working, handoff, responder, and closed, with events empty when there are none. cursor is the last event returned, or the request's cursor if there were none; the spec doesn't say what it is for an empty read without a cursor, so null is allowed.
